market_hypothesis: A first BTC traversal of already-known short-term external dealing-range liquidity is a failed auction when at least two of ETH, SOL and XRP reject the analogous directional sweep, BTC returns inside the old range, the futures-index proxy and executed flow reverse together, a pre-sweep internal structure is displaced with an FVG, and a separate later FVG retest holds. The position targets only pre-existing opposite external liquidity.

state_contract.external_liquidity: pre-event 60-minute completed dealing-range high or low, shifted by one minute
state_contract.first_sweep: BTC alone traverses the known edge by at least 0.02 ATR from an inside previous close
state_contract.cross_market_asymmetry: at least two of ETH, SOL and XRP do not both wick through their analogous edge and accept with a past-only tail directional return
state_contract.failed_auction: BTC closes back inside the swept range within three completed minutes
state_contract.confirmation: opposite flow and return, futures-index proxy agreement, break of the pre-sweep internal boundary, past-only displacement and a directional FVG
state_contract.entry: a separate later FVG retest holds
state_contract.invalidation: beyond the full BTC sweep extreme plus 0.05 ATR
state_contract.target: nearest pre-existing intact opposite external liquidity with at least 1.20R after costs; measured moves prohibited

single_precommitted_ablation_if_baseline.interpretation: Tests whether cross-market SMT asymmetry is the alpha source or merely a scarcity filter. All other state, cost, risk, target and execution contracts remain unchanged.
